title: Tumor-derived KLK5 activates TMEM158cancer-associated fibroblasts to induce CD8T cell exhaustion and confer immunotherapy resistance in lung cancer.
publicationName: Drug resistance updates : reviews and commentaries in antimicrobial and anticancer chemotherapy
journalName: Drug resistance updates : reviews and commentaries in antimicrobial and anticancer chemotherapy
snippet: Immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) has improved the treatment landscape of lung squamous cell carcinoma (LUSC), but durable clinical benefit is limited by frequent therapeutic resistance.
